We're thrilled to announce the release of Patch 6 for Hotel Renovator, packed with fixes and improvements to enhance your renovation experience. Here's a rundown of what's been addressed.

Patch Notes:


 We've restored the missing visual effect for surface destruction, making your renovation efforts more satisfying than ever.
 We've fixed the issue that prevented the removal of paint from panels after panel destruction. Now you can renovate with precision and without any lingering paint woes.

 Say goodbye to texture delays! We've optimized the loading of textures for player-affected surfaces, enhancing overall performance.
 We've fixed the issue causing simultaneous tips to appear on unrenovated additional floors, providing clearer guidance during renovations.
 Enjoy precise wall decoration placement on the third floor! Minimalist Wall Panel 3 and Deco Wall Panel 3 can no longer be placed separately from the wall.
 NPC heads are now solid! We've eliminated the issue of seeing through NPC heads for a more immersive experience.
 Objects will stay where they belong! We've prevented objects from being placed outside the hotel boundaries.
 Renovate without performance hiccups! FPS drops after placing multiple cleaning robots have been addressed.
 Stay informed about your mods! We've added warnings to alert you when installed mods become unavailable.

Get ready to dive back into the world of Hotel Renovator with Patch 6, and experience smoother, more polished renovations than ever before.

notes.title: Make your hotel profitable
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/e8a149c46739aa0dda3937e6ac3359b53c25aa05.png

The economy of running a hotel is a complicated and layered task, but in Hotel Renovator, it’s pretty easy to grasp. To be successful, a hotel needs to be profitable and provide high-quality services to the guests. All that while maintaining a positive reputation to attract more and more guests. In Hotel Renovator, we captured the essence of running a hotel by considering several economic factors without overly complicated bookkeeping.

The critical factor is obviously the income generated through the sale of accessible rooms. Room prices will vary depending on the quality of the finishing and furnishing, and the rate at which you sell available rooms will significantly impact your income. Rooms with a higher rating can be sold at a higher rate, but not all guests are willing to pay more for their stay. That means you must maintain a healthy balance to attract guests of all wallet sizes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/26da22cb0762e5694416f1880365a29e947e5e2b.gif

Expenses are as equally important as income. A successful business will only keep afloat if the income is higher than the cost of operation. With every new room, your water and energy expenses will increase, so you need to be sure that the occupancy of the hotel is high enough to cover them. The best way to save money is to do most of the repairs and cleaning yourself, but once your hotel grows in size, you will be tempted to hire room service staff and a handyman.

Providing a high level of customer service is essential for a hotel to attract and retain guests. Some factors contributing to customer satisfaction include the cleanliness of rooms and common areas, and the availability of amenities such as a swimming pool, a cafe and a restaurant. Finishing the rooms according to your guests' Style Suggestions will also impact satisfaction and grant extra bonuses. Customers may be more satisfied with their stay if their room is neighbouring one occupied by a VIP, but on the other hand, a noisy or dirty neighbour might be a cause of concern.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/2cfd939fc4f9e33d5523e68f799f55e04e4e14b9.png

Last but not least is the hotel’s reputation. Just as in real life, reputation can significantly impact its ability to attract new guests. If you maintain an efficiently run and clean hotel with access to attractive amenities, your hotel will get a higher ranking. With each awarded star, you will unlock more and more features and items to make your hotel even more popular. Keeping a high standard of your rooms and taking good care of your guests will increase its reputation and allow you to get more income.  

TLDR: The economy of Hotel Renovator involves balancing the need to generate income with the need to control expenses while also providing high levels of customer service and maintaining a positive reputation. Are you up to the task?

These could vary from specific wall colours to the tiniest details, such as the number of candles or plants that they want to have in their rooms. Making your guest happy will raise the overall score of your hotel and earn you more money for your efforts.

Make sure to check The Journal frequently to find any additional information about your guests and their preferences and to keep a close eye on your hotel’s economy.

Must-have 5: Indirect light source, like a small wall lamp

notes.title: Designer Corner # 7 - Interior Lighting
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/918d0e978a696de000706731b3668ee45f4e198e.png

The amount of lighting in a room can significantly affect its appearance and usability. Lights should be selected due to their usability and the function they perform. 

How can you properly illuminate a room?

Artificial light is an imitation of natural light, which is the sunlight. There should be three types of lights in every room:


 The leading light - takes the central place in the room. Its task is to illuminate the room evenly. The lamp should be selected according to the room size. It would be, for example, a large chandelier or a slender pendant lamp.

 Task light - is the light that we use when performing a specific activity. It is, for example, a standing desk lamp, a table lamp, or a wall lamp. It should have adjustable stands.

 Decorative light - is an additional light that serves only as a decorative element and gives a subtle touch of illumination.  It could be a crystal wall lamp or other small, designer lights.


Thanks to the lighting, you can create exciting interiors that will attract the eyes and delight your visitors. For a long time, it has been known that the combination of plants and light gives an exciting result in shadow play.

How to influence the room's appearance?

Lighting directed at the ceiling optically enlarges the room. The light illuminating the floor gives the impression of a lower and darker interior. Darkening the lower zones of the walls enlarges the space visually. Lighting a room with wall lamps makes the interior seem smaller.

Light color temperature

Each room requires the correct color of light. Choosing a warm or cool color has a functional significance and affects our mood and well-being.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/c58d0ec999617bfc836c662ec177e61e57b1c96e.png

Warm lighting affects our minds to feel more relaxed and at ease. But a cool lighting turns into a blue and is best for everyday work.

The oriental style is inspired by various cultures - from India, full of colors and splendor, to the classy and refined Japan.

Features: diversity, splendor, wealth, exoticism, respect for traditional craftsmanship and handicraft, expressiveness
Colors: saturated reds, greens, yellows, as well as purple, orange, and pink, complemented by white and black
Materials: exotic wood, bamboo, wicker, metal, glass, paper
Accessories: Moroccan or Chinese lanterns, incense sticks, small decorated tables, Chinese porcelain, Buddha figurines, fabrics with oriental patterns


The oriental style of lighting is much different from the European one. It often uses the Moroccan-style lamps and lanterns made out of metal or gourds or light paper lamps from the Far East.

The colors of the oriental style are intense. It is primarily red, which symbolizes happiness in Chinese culture. Saturated shades of green and yellow and the color of dark wood are also welcome here.

The oriental arrangement wouldn’t be complete without specific fabrics. Pillows or curtains can be shiny, decorated with traditional patterns. Carpets should also appear in the designs.

If you plan to design an apartment in an oriental style, you have many arrangement possibilities. Choose oriental furniture and items carefully, guided primarily by their quality - be inspired, but do not copy, avoid literalism by looking at current trends.

notes.title: Designer’s Corner #4 - How to arrange the corridor?
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/9a537240d14953f34c658b31482c27326d5d4638.png

The corridor is our showcase. It’s the first room we see when we enter our house or other places, so we need to focus on the functionality of this room and, of course, on the furniture. It is worth bringing decorations and accessories to the front.

The key to success in finishing any interior design is consistency. A small room will visually gain a few centimeters if we focus on light colors (beige, gray, white, etc.).

A bright corridor doesn't have to be boring. You can break the monotony by painting one wall in a darker color. Brick walls or properly selected wall decorations can also be a nice change.

Some of the most commonly used in wall decorations:


 brick or stone
 wall cladding
 wall panel
 decorative wallpaper
 mural
 decorative plasters


For the floor, the most commonly used are:


 wooden parquet
 laminate panels
 porcelain tiles
 resin
 stone
 PVC floor coverings


How would you decorate the corridor walls?

Use mirrors, as they optically enlarge space and work great when paired with paintings and wall lamps, illuminated strips, or even bookshelves. To finish it off, a table with a flower vase and a fluffy rug will beautifully warm the corridor interior.

notes.title: Designer’s Corner #3 - Classic Style
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/1814398125ef3eb4b7a3c97495e75d1b73c22f27.png

The Classic Style is characterized by warm colors and matching furniture arrangements. The most important features of this style are simplicity and class. In modern times, classic style is often associated with minimalism and top-shelf accessories. It’s often defined as the English style. The main pillars here are simplicity, balance, and symmetry.

Characteristic colors:


 browns
 beige
 gray
 whites


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/8490157935851df60741a2c468741ace755c9b0d.png

An excellent example of a classic style is a bright interior with white walls and dark wood furniture with golden accessories. Subdued colors and natural materials such as wood can be matched with wallpapers in light pastel colors with small patterns. The design can be finished with stuccos on the ceiling, moldings, and cornices.

Consistency is an essential aspect of the Classic Style. The whole interior should be held together by a characteristic element, such as the color of furniture or fabrics.

The classic style looks best when used in large spaces, with wooden windows, elegant lamps, and high-quality furniture. It’s a posh style suitable for classy people.

notes.title: Designer’s Corner #2 - Halloween Gothic
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/dceb1ff2b2c25be560fab0e9769627c256675514.png

Gothic Style 
One of the most unusual interior design styles. It reflects an atmosphere of luxury and personality and it’s characterized by dark colors of walls, floors, and ceilings. Gothic Style is easily recognized by decorative patterns and materials, such as ornamented wood, forged metal or stained glass. 

Here are some features of the Gothic style:


 Dark shades of colors are used for dramatic effect, for example, burgundy, navy blue, dark brown, or black.
 The furniture usually has dark upholstery, and the accessories are most of the time contrasting it, for example in red or purple, and even white colors.
 Several different materials are usually used for the floors, such as tiles with white patterns, carpets or pure white wood.
 Fancy wallpapers are very fitting, especially ones with ornament patterns
 It’s good to experiment with lighting. Using elegant chandeliers and wall lamps creates the perfect atmosphere.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/ef0e9bb303ea8edb83ef27acd1f5afa330b47b27.png

Gothic is often associated with a spooky look. Black castles, vampires, ghosts, graveyards - the theme is a scary one. Let’s take advantage of the Halloween season and create a climatic Hotel Renovator demo interior!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/f00e04ef6e8ae0e4c197d608ae2f7620c2a92094.png

Fairy tale look, with noble knights, generous kings, and beautiful princesses is difficult to recreate without elegant armchairs, solid carved chests, and painted canopies over the beds. Beautiful and expensive semi-antique furniture is an indispensable element of a gothic interior.

Good luck with your projects! I’m waiting for your design screenshots on our Discord channel. See you in the next one!
